description: Flat list of enriched parquet files for the LoadData StateMachine. Table names are resolved by the Pipe enrichment Lambda; Size is optional and backfilled via boto3 when absent (e.g. manual runs).

SourceFile.description: S3 object key (not full URI) of the source file.

TableName.description: Target Iceberg table name resolved from the file name.

Size.description: Object size in bytes (from the S3 event). Optional — backfilled via HeadObject when omitted.
